mentions.name: k3s/k8s-based GitHub Actions runner
mentions.description: A self-hosted GitHub Actions runner built on k3s/k8s that supports macOS and Linux workloads, intended to replace paid GitHub-hosted runner minutes.
mentions.problem: Compute is precious and GitHub-hosted Actions minutes cost the author at least $25 per month.
mentions.source_excerpt: Compute is precious, so I’m building a k3s/k8s-based macOS/Linux GitHub Actions runner.

evidence.value: Compute is precious, so I’m building a k3s/k8s-based macOS/Linux GitHub Actions runner.
